BAO CAO MAY NHA  [VANG]  2026-10-03T19:06:55
TOM LAI:
- Suc khoe may: XANH - on (CPU 5.0%, RAM trong 26.56 GB, cam ket con lai 29.95 GB).
- O ~78% CPU (16 viec song song) may dat 87% toc do toi da; ket qua toi da chi ~x7.8 so voi chay 1 viec. Luong ao (hyperthreading) cho them 38% so voi chi dung nhan vat ly.
- Giu tran CPU 75-80% la dung: chay 100% chi them ~13% toc do ma may giat.
- Cai nghen thuc su: viec doc nhieu bo nho (quet M1 nhieu nam, agent MT5) chi chay hieu qua ~2 viec cung luc du may co 20 luong; viec nhe nam trong cache thi chay duoc ~20.
- MT5: tao toi da 5 tai khoan demo (moi terminal 1 tai khoan); nhieu hon khong nhanh hon vi bang thong RAM chi nuoi noi ~5 agent nang. Neu XM cho 1 tai khoan dang nhap nhieu terminal thi chi can 1.
CHU DU AN CAN LAM:

1. Them RAM CUNG LOAI voi thanh dang co (DDR4 32.0 GB, 2133 MT/s; ma hang M386A4G40DM0-CPB) vao khe KHAC KENH (xem so tay bo mach: khe vi tri 1 cua moi kenh). Them 1 thanh: 1 -> 2 kenh, bang thong ly thuyet gap 2.0 lan; them du 3 thanh: 4 kenh, gap 4.0 lan. Khong tron RDIMM voi LRDIMM; chua chac thi gui anh nhan thanh dang co de chon dung loai.

2. File trang (pagefile): dat 1 file CO DINH tren o HDD moi (goi y 62 GB, dau = toi da, khong de Windows tu co gian) lam LUOI AN TOAN chong loi het bo nho (da xay ra 13/09). Khong lam bo nho lam viec: HDD cham ~100 lan SSD, neu phai doc/ghi lien tuc thi may dung hinh. Giu file trang nho tren SSD. Xem tai_lieu/MAY_NHA_TOI_UU.md
3. Ke hoach dien dang la Balanced: doi sang High performance (powercfg /setactive 8c5e7fda-e8bf-4a96-9a85-a6e23a8c635c) de CPU khong ha xung / khong ngu nhan
PHIEN NHA / MAY TU LAM:
- Cai trinh bien dich de bat nhan C (nhanh hon ~100 lan): `pip install ziglang` (~80 MB, mot lan), roi `python -m nhan.luoi_nhan` de no tu kiem
- Dat tran CPU cua he = 78 (giua dai 75-80): `b tran-cpu 78` (mac dinh trong code la 85)
SO LIEU:
- May: Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU E5-2630 v4 @ 2.20GHz, 10 nhan / 20 luong, RAM 32.0 GB (1 thanh, khe trong 15, 1 kenh dang dung).

- Engine luoi (Python - CHUA co nhan C, chuoi gia lap 60k nen nam trong cache): o ~80% CPU ~5,184 luot thu/gio, toi da ~5,940 (1 luot = 1 bo tham so tren 1 trieu nen; chuoi that co the cham hon 2-3 lan).
- Bang thong RAM do duoc: dinh 11.4 GB/giay (66% cua muc ly thuyet 17.1 GB/s), het loi tu ~2 viec song song.
- Dia cham (kieu HDD): E: - khong dat du lieu lich su tester / file trang chinh o day.

- MT5 tran: tran thap nhat la bang_thong (cpu=16, ram=9, bang_thong=5, dia=44); them terminal/tai khoan vuot 5 khong nhanh hon vi chi chia nhau cung mot may; che do toi uu hoa: 1 terminal dung toi da 5 agent. [RAM moi agent la GIA DINH 2.5 GB: do lai khi co agent chay].
